verses.1: A Canticle Psalm, of David himself.
verses.2: My heart is prepared, O God, my heart is prepared. I will sing songs, and I will sing psalms in my glory.
verses.3: Rise up, my glory. Rise up, Psalter and harp. I will arise in early morning.
verses.4: I will confess to you, O Lord, among the peoples. And I will sing psalms to you among the nations.
verses.5: For your mercy is great, beyond the heavens, and your truth, even to the clouds.
verses.6: Be exalted, O God, beyond the heavens, and your glory, beyond all the earth,
verses.7: so that your beloved may be freed. Save with your right hand, and heed me.
verses.8: God has spoken in his holiness. I will exult, and I will divide Shechem, and I will divide by measure the steep valley of tabernacles.
verses.9: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the supporter of my head. Judah is my king.
verses.10: Moab is the cooking pot of my hope. I will extend my shoe in Idumea; the foreigners have become my friends.
verses.11: Who will lead me into the fortified city? Who will lead me, even into Idumea?
verses.12: Will not you, O God, who had rejected us? And will not you, O God, go out with our armies?
verses.13: Grant us help from tribulation, for vain is the help of man.
verses.14: In God, we will act virtuously, and he will bring our enemies to nothing. [ Psalm 108 ] (109)
